nodes.description: Public uint256 maximumTokens: total NFT supply cap, used in remaining-supply checks.
Private uint256 _reserveTokens: tokens reserved for owner distribution, decremented in giveawayEmeeji.
Public uint256 tokenPrice: current mint price per token, used to validate msg.value.
Public uint256 purchaseLimit: maximum tokens mintable per transaction.
Public uint256 numberMinted: running count of minted tokens, seed for token ids.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) percPayout: percentage share per payee.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) payoutAmount: credited ETH per payee, zeroed on withdraw.
Private address[] payees: list of payout recipients iterated in approvePayouts.
Bool reentrancyLock: naive reentrancy guard set/cleared inside orderEmeejis.
Bool orderLock: sales switch toggled by lockOrders/unlockOrders.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) _balances: ERC721 balance ledger.
Private mapping(uint256=>address) _owners: ERC721 token ownership ledger.
Private address _owner in Ownable: privileged owner account used by onlyOwner.
Public payable mint entrypoint: validates payment/limits, credits payouts, mints tokens via _safeMint and refunds change with a raw call.
External onlyOwner function minting reserved tokens to an address, decrementing _reserveTokens and incrementing numberMinted.
External payout function: zeroes payoutAmount[msg.sender] then forwards ETH with a raw call.
Internal function accumulating payoutAmount for every payee based on percPayout percentages.
Internal ERC721 safe mint that calls _mint and then _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
Internal ERC721 mint updating _balances and _owners.
Receive hook that credits approvePayouts with any plain ETH transfer.
Fallback payable hook that credits approvePayouts with any unknown-calldata ETH transfer.
Private function invoking onERC721Received on contract recipients (external callback).
External burn restricted to the token owner via _msgSender() == _owners[tokenId].
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for minting, payouts, withdrawals and authorization checks.
Raw low-level msg.sender.call{value: cashChange} sending ETH refund inside orderEmeejis.
Raw low-level msg.sender.call{value: payout} sending ETH inside withdraw.
External call to IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received on attacker-controlled contract recipient.
Parameter orderSize of orderEmeejis: number of tokens requested in one purchase.
Parameter numberToMint of giveawayEmeeji: number of reserved tokens to mint.
Parameter _to of giveawayEmeeji: recipient of giveaway tokens.
Parameter purchaseAmount of approvePayouts: ETH amount distributed as payout credit.
Local cashChange in orderEmeejis: msg.value minus orderSize*tokenPrice, refunded by raw call.
Local mintSeedValue in orderEmeejis: numberMinted snapshot used to derive token ids.
Local payout in withdraw: payoutAmount[msg.sender] forwarded via raw call.
Local cashIn in orderEmeejis: msg.value captured and passed to approvePayouts.
Local currentToken in giveawayEmeeji: numberMinted snapshot used to derive token ids.

edges.reason: orderSize parameter drives the mint loop and price validation in orderEmeejis.
msg.sender is read for the mint recipient and for the reentrancy/order checks in orderEmeejis.
tokenPrice is multiplied by orderSize to validate msg.value in orderEmeejis.
purchaseLimit bounds the requested orderSize.
orderLock gates whether orderEmeejis can execute at all.
reentrancyLock is set and cleared around the mint/refund flow in orderEmeejis.
numberMinted is read to derive mintSeedValue and the remaining supply arithmetic.
maximumTokens participates in the remaining-supply subtraction inside orderEmeejis.
_reserveTokens is subtracted when checking remaining mintable supply.
cashChange is computed as cashIn minus orderSize*tokenPrice.
orderSize multiplied by tokenPrice determines the refunded cashChange.
orderEmeejis invokes approvePayouts with the received ETH.
local cashIn is passed as purchaseAmount into approvePayouts.
approvePayouts credits payoutAmount for each payee.
percPayout percentage of each payee is read when computing their share.
payees array is iterated to distribute payout credits.
orderEmeejis calls _safeMint once per ordered token.
msg.sender is the mint recipient passed to _safeMint.
mintSeedValue plus loop index supplies the tokenId to _safeMint.
_safeMint delegates state mutation to _mint.
_safeMint triggers the ERC721 receiver callback check after minting.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received call on the recipient.
The receiver callback can re-enter orderEmeejis while reentrancyLock is still set (guard is cleared only after the loop and refund).
The receiver callback can re-enter withdraw during the mint flow.
orderEmeejis performs a raw ETH refund via call before clearing reentrancyLock.
msg.sender is the target of the refund low-level call.
cashChange is the value forwarded in the refund call.
The raw refund call transfers control to msg.sender which may re-enter orderEmeejis before reentrancyLock is released.
withdraw sends the payout through a raw low-level call.
local payout is the value forwarded by the withdraw call.
msg.sender is the target of the payout low-level call.
The payout call can re-enter withdraw; state is cleared before the call so the classic pattern is largely mitigated.
withdraw reads payoutAmount[msg.sender] and zeroes it before transferring.
msg.sender selects which payoutAmount entry the caller may withdraw.
receive() credits payouts for plain ETH transfers.
fallback() credits payouts for unmatched calldata ETH transfers.
numberToMint controls the mint loop bound in giveawayEmeeji.
_to is the recipient passed to _safeMint in giveawayEmeeji.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against owner() before allowing giveawayEmeeji.
_owner state backs the owner() check guarding giveawayEmeeji.
_reserveTokens is decremented while distributed reserved tokens remain.
numberMinted is incremented and used as the token id base in giveawayEmeeji.
giveawayEmeeji mints through _safeMint.
currentToken plus loop index supplies the tokenId to _safeMint.
burn requires _msgSender() to equal the recorded token owner.
_owners[tokenId] is read to authorize the burn caller.
_mint increments _balances[to] by one.
_mint writes the new owner into _owners[tokenId].

normalization_plan.reason: orderSize is only meaningful as the mint amount argument of orderEmeejis and should collapse into that call site.
numberToMint is a local-only count argument of giveawayEmeeji with no independent identity.
_to is only the recipient argument of giveawayEmeeji and should be folded into the function node.
purchaseAmount is the sole ETH input of approvePayouts and carries no separate semantic role.
cashChange is a short-lived temporary inside orderEmeejis that only feeds the refund call.
mintSeedValue is a snapshot of numberMinted used only inside the orderEmeejis mint loop.
payout is a transient copy of payoutAmount[msg.sender] used only inside withdraw.
cashIn is just the msg.value captured at the start of orderEmeejis.
currentToken is a snapshot of numberMinted used only inside giveawayEmeeji.
